covers: The first byte of an OKI MSM6295 command

entries.name: stop voices
entries.description: Stops the voices selected by bits 3 to 6, when no phrase number is pending.
entries.behaviour: Bit 3 stops voice 1, bit 4 voice 2, bit 5 voice 3 and bit 6 voice 4; the stream is updated first. When a phrase number is pending the same byte is read as the second half of a start instead, so a stop never follows a start byte.

entries.name: select phrase
entries.description: First byte of a start: the phrase number to play.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 to 6 are the phrase number, kept for the next byte. Its bits 4 to 7 pick voices and bits 0 to 3 the volume: 0 full, 8 is -24 dB, 9 to 15 silent. A phrase starts only on a stopped voice whose ROM-table start address is below its stop, both masked to 18 bits.
